meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Cloudways vs Kinsta: Price, Speed and Offers (2026)
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways vs Kinsta compared on entry price, speed tests, AI features, support and Black Friday offers, using each host's own pages and named tests from 2026.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways costs less to start and lists more AI tools. Kinsta costs more and lists a money-back guarantee and human support.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Cloudways better than Kinsta? | Neither wins every round. Cloudways costs less to start and lists more AI tools. Kinsta lists human support and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Which is cheaper, Cloudways or Kinsta? | Cloudways' entry plan lists at $14 a month and Kinsta's at $35 a month. The plans are not the same size.
Which has the better Black Friday deal? | Cloudways offers 80% off for 2 months with no end date shown. Kinsta offers 50% off for 3 months, or 3 months free on annual billing, ending 1 December 2026.
Is Kinsta faster than Cloudways? | The tests used different servers and methods. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime for Kinsta, and DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A for Cloudways. They are not directly comparable.
Do both host WordPress? | Yes. Kinsta hosts WordPress only. Cloudways hosts WordPress and other apps.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Cloudways lists at $14 a month and Kinsta at $35.
Cloudways lists a 5-day free trial. Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Kinsta's Black Friday offer ends 1 December. Cloudways shows no end date.
The two tests used different methods and are not a race.
meta.rl_c_a_desc: Managed cloud hosting with a choice of providers
meta.rl_c_a_choose: you want a cloud server, a low start and AI tools.
meta.rl_c_b_choose: you want WordPress-only hosting with strong support and can pay for it.

meta.rl_c_winners:
You want the lowest start | A | $14 a month at list price.
You want a guarantee | B | A 30-day money-back guarantee is listed.
You want AI tools with your hosting | A | Copilot and AI Agents plans are listed.
You run a business site and want support | B | 24/7 human support in 8 languages is listed.
meta.rl_c_both: Some people use Cloudways for small projects and Kinsta for a key client site. Both let you try the service on a new site first.
meta.rl_c_verdict: Cloudways costs less to start and lists more AI tools. Kinsta costs more and lists a money-back guarantee and human support. Neither host was tested by us.
